quote: The 90-day renewal notice deadline is **August 16, 2026** (90 days before November 14, 2026). ... If it was not delivered by August 16, 2026, the Distribution Agreement expires by its own terms on November 14, 2026, before the Closing. In that scenario: - The § 3.12(c) representation that the Distribution Agreement "remains in effect through November 2029" is false as of the Signing Date and will remain false at Closing. - Quillon would have a basis to terminate the MIPA under § 9.1(c) ... or to claim indemnification post-closing under § 8.2(a).
